idea-plugin.name: Markdown Live Image
idea-plugin.description:
Visual & Organized Markdown Editing

Live Markdown enhances your IntelliJ IDEA experience by bringing seamless image management and real-time visual feedback directly into your Markdown editor.

Main Features:

  • Inline Image Rendering: No more separate preview windows! View images directly within the editor's text area as you type. It provides a true "What You See Is What You Get" experience for your documentation.
  • Flexible Storage Paths: Take full control of your project structure. You can customize exactly where pasted images are stored, ensuring your assets are organized according to your project's conventions.
  • Smart Image Paste: Paste images directly from your clipboard. The plugin automatically saves the file to your designated directory and generates the Markdown link instantly.
  • Seamless Workflow: Reduce context switching and focus on content by seeing your visuals and text in one unified workspace.

Streamline your documentation process with organized image management and instant inline previews.
